title: WorktreeReadyReport
description: The output of `mise run kb-worktree-ready`: what `kb_setup.worktree.prepare_existing` did to make a fresh `git worktree` usable — which required source clones and graph files it found already present, CoW-copied from the main checkout, or had to skip because the donor lacked them, plus the donor's own identity so a stale donor graph reads as stale rather than certified current. A closed set (`created`/`already-present`/`skipped`) typed as a bare `str` fails SILENTLY here — see `reviewed-classification.schema.json`'s own description for the two-`kb-build`-run cost of that shape — so this is generated rather than hand-written.

target.description: The worktree this run made ready, as an absolute path.

donor.description: The main checkout the clones and graph files were copied from.

donor_graph.description: The donor's graph.json identity (path, size, mtime), or "absent".

items.description: One row per required clone and per required graph file.

name.description: The repo-relative path this row describes, e.g. sources/graphify.

detail.description: The copied clone's HEAD, or why it was skipped.
